decisions.reason: The accepted Apollo transfer path does not specify whether normal LinkedIn profile URLs or Sales Navigator URLs are transferred, so the candidate's ambiguity remains unresolved.
Changing the lead-transfer path through Apollo does not determine how existing CRM records are identified or where duplicate status is displayed.
The accepted transfer workflow concerns lead ingestion and email enrichment, not the visibility of email and LinkedIn chat history in HubSpot lead records.
The source changes the inbound Sales Navigator-to-HubSpot route; it does not change the separate, deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization requirement.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording automatic email enrichment after leads are saved in Apollo, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
The Apollo-to-HubSpot ingestion alternative does not change the separate workflow for recirculating silent leads and exporting follow-up lists to MeetAlfred.
The accepted Sales Navigator-to-Apollo-to-HubSpot route does not alter the independent MeetAlfred account configuration requirement.
The source does not remove or modify the Zapier account configuration requirement, which supports the separate HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred integration.
